title: Halving the original Kalton--Roberts upper bound for nearly additive set functions
summary: Let $K_{KR}$ be the least constant governing uniform approximation of approximately additive real-valued set functions by finitely additive signed measures. We prove that $$K_{KR}\le\frac{374167}{20000}=18.70835.$$ Starting from a norming functional for best uniform approximation, we form two families of almost extremal sets with complementary point frequencies. Intersections and biregular expanders then give two recombination schemes.
